coaching.headline: We won 30 of the match's credited kills, but towers still went 3 to 10 against us and we lost the game.
coaching.team: Lane reads were mixed across the draft: jungle (Aurora vs Crunch) and carry (Eden vs Skylar) came in favored, while midlane (Wraith vs Gadget) and offlane (Bayle vs Terra) read unfavored all game. Early objective trades were close: we won the Fangtooth fight at 9.5 but still conceded the objective, and lost the 14.9 Fangtooth fight outright 1-3, and we converted only 2 of 5 won fights into prizes all match. At 21.8 we had the man advantage, 5 against 4, and still lost the fight 2-4 at our own Fangtooth. From there towers mounted against us, 10 to 3, even as we held our own on kills (30 credited). The collapse came at 31.7, when Crunch alone killed all five of us in 42 seconds near Orb Prime, and the Inhibitor fight at 34.9 opened the Core a minute later.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: At 21.8, a 5-vs-4 man advantage at Fangtooth should have been a clean win; instead we lost it 2-4, and from there structures swung hard to them (10 towers to 3).
coaching.whatWorked: Eden's two solo kills at their Outer Tower (17.7, 17.8) — picking off Dekker then Skylar alone — opened the game's only clean, sustained push.

focus.title: Four solo catches, two towers gone
focus.evidence: Aurora was caught alone at 18.4 and 20.4, Bayle at 19, and Mourn at 19.7 — each died outside any team fight, and those four catches directly preceded the Outer Tower falls at 19.5 and 21.
focus.action: After a fight is lost, regroup to a tower instead of roaming solo — the next life lost alone should not also be the next structure lost.

14.9.call: A 4-player fight at Fangtooth went 1-3 while both midlane and offlane were alive but pinned in losing lanes — we took Mini Prime in the same window, so read it as a trade, not a clean loss.

21.8.call: We had bodies up, 5 against 4, at Fangtooth and still lost the fight 2-4 — that's a fight to win with the man advantage, not one to trade away.

27.2.call: We opened this fight a body down, 4 against 5, after Cuban Noobster's death 27 seconds earlier — the numbers were lost before the fight was; the win (4-3) still gave up Primal Fangtooth across the map.

31.7.call: Crunch alone killed all five of us in the span between 31.7 and 32.4 near Orb Prime — a full wipe with zero kills back; that fight needed to be declined or spaced out, not grouped into.

34.9.call: A 2-5 loss at our Inhibitor opened the Core a minute later, part of the same collapse that left the final tower count 3 to 10.

f372d61d-45f4-44fc-9d0d-e6a8e36962d1.build: Bayle finished only Rapture of the meta core (Overlord, Rapture, Cursed Scroll), running Tainted Blade, Citadel, and Mutilator alongside it; his three catches were early roams and a mid-fight pick, not fights the missing damage items clearly decided.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Mourn swapped the meta's Hexbound Bracers and Enra's Blessing for Raiment of Renewal, Elafrost, and Xenia — a sustain-leaning build that fits an unfavored lane, though the match doesn't show the swap costing or gaining a specific fight.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: The engine doesn't model support Eternals, so any Eternal read for Mourn is a general peel/sustain suggestion, never his actual pick.

31848d6b-a49a-4d1e-99ff-df0546ea76ca.build: Aurora skipped Elafrost and Gaia Greaves, the jungle core's control and mobility pieces, finishing only Magnify with Spectral Schematics, Tainted Guard, and Overseer instead; three separate solo catches (18.4, 20.4, 33.9) followed, each costing a tower or more, though the match can't prove the items were the cause.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: On-core build — Solaris, Vanquisher, and Nuclear Rounds all completed, plus Terminus and Viper beyond it — nothing to fix in the items this game.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~2.3s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Mourn Abduct (pull). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
ourKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

ourKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
ourKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

ourKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
ourKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
enemyKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
enemyKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it
